source_note: PARSEC publishes no isochrone packages: the official CMD web form (https://stev.oapd.inaf.it/cgi-bin/cmd) computes isochrone tables server-side on request and is the isochrone acquisition channel (scriptable with a complete current field set, verified live 2026-10-14). The host's TLS chain omits its intermediate CA (ZeroSSL RSA DV SSL CA 2); the bundled intermediate completes the chain so verification stays on.
scope_note: Isochrone products computed by the CMD web form (request-layer client: stellariso.models.parsec.cmd_form). The PARSEC track archives are out of scope; historical pre-2006 tracks on pleiadi.oapd.inaf.it remain out of scope as well.
